model.name: Binary content is represented WITHIN the unit — base64 inline on the wire, .content sidecar + sha256 hash-dedup at rest
model.description: Binary is carried WITHIN the scenario unit, not as a separate payload: base64 inline on the wire; at rest, the existing .content sidecar + a sha256 content-hash that DEDUPS identical bytes (same hash = one stored blob, no-op re-store). The natural class owns the toUnit/fromUnit conversion (R40.99 interface).
